summary: A planned restart first asks the seat for its handoff, then stops it at the acknowledgement or a two-minute deadline

replay.detail: No claim kind or field changes. The daemon appends ordinary message.sent and runtime.reconcile-decision claims; a seat acknowledges with a custom.agent.restart-ready claim, a kind the store already accepts.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes or triggers change.

rules.detail: Admission and authority are unchanged. The reserved message tag prefix st3-restart-prepare: joins the daemon-only tags, so a seat cannot send one.

compatibility.detail: An explicit restart, a pool switch at a limit and a declaration change applied to a running, ready seat now wait up to two minutes for the seat to write its handoff or run st agents handoff ready before the seat is stopped. A seat that is not up and ready is restarted at once, as before. New command st agents handoff ready.

downtime.detail: A restart of a ready seat takes up to two minutes longer when the seat does not answer. st agents restart waits ten minutes by default, so it still succeeds.

recovery.detail: Rolling back removes the wait; restarts go ahead at once as before.
